subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After every coupled immutable-pin assertion is repaired, do the workflow and security owners approve these fourteen third-party action revisions for privileged automation?
rationale: Source inspection establishes official provenance and identifies mechanical defects, but accepting new executable revisions that receive tokens, secrets, publishing access, and scanning permissions requires repository-owner judgment.

options.title: Repair and owner-review
options.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow checks, and obtain the routed workflow and security owner approvals before merge.

options.title: Replace the bot branch
options.body: Create a stable maintainer-controlled grouped dependency update if repeated Dependabot rebases continue discarding the coupled repairs.

recommendation.title: Repair and owner-review
recommendation.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow checks, and obtain the routed workflow and security owner approvals before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current guard assertions trace to this person's merged history, and the root workflow ownership path provides the strongest individual routing signal.
